about: One real answer of the command GitHubProviderAdapter.pr_get runs, recorded by scripts/record_gh_pr_view.py with the owner's gh sign-in. Never hand-edit it.

stdout.body:
Betterment MCP slice **M2** (`docs/internal/betterment/mcp/RECIPE.md`).

## What changed
- **Recording (hub).** `POST /api/mcp` hands each answered call of an `agent:run:<run_id>` credential to `services/run_trace.record_call`, which adds one row to a new additive table `agent_run_calls`: tool, effect (`read` / `write` / `prepare`), the object touched as a qualified ref with its title, and the time. Refused calls add nothing; list/search calls keep `ref` empty.
- **Link to the result.** `cli_engine_runs` gains `run_id` and `item_id` (additive). The workbench runner names the item around its engine call (`run_trace.for_item`, a contextvar), so a result finds its runs, its tool calls and its cost.
- **Wire.** Each result in `GET /api/workbenches/{id}` (and `workbench.get` over MCP, the same payload) now carries `cost_usd` (the CLI's reported cost, summed over the item's runs; null if none) and `used` (`looked_at`, `wrote` with `undo` for what the run made, `prepared` with `send_id` and `destination`; null when nothing was touched). `workbench.results` does not exist yet (M3), so nothing was added there.
- **Face.** `ResultCard` draws three folded lines: *Looked at* `3 meetings` (each read object by name, a link), *Wrote* `1 note` (link, plus **Undo** through the desk's one delete when a receipt seat is shown, else withheld), *Prepared* `1 send` (the document to its destination, with the existing Send fold). Nothing when empty. The head line already showed `cost_usd`; it now arrives.

## How it was proven
- T1 `tests/integration/test_desk_engines_tools.py::test_a_result_says_what_its_agent_looked_at_and_wrote_and_what_it_cost`: real hub, fake `claude` CLI that calls `meeting.list`, `meeting.get` x3, `desk.create` (a note), `channel.prepare` and a refused `channel.send`. Asserts the 3 meetings by title and ref, 1 note with undo and a real `/api/notes/{id}`, the prepared send with its destination and nothing in the folder, and the summed cost.
- T2 `web/src/desk/__tests__/automation.app.test.tsx` "Looked at, Wrote, Prepared" (4 tests) on the recorded answers of that run (`automation-hub/used.json`, `HOLDSPEAK_WIRE_WRITE=1`). The other automation-hub answers were re-recorded for the two new result fields.
- `scripts/quick_check.sh`: GREEN (vitest related 32 passed; pytest affected 935 passed, 1 skipped; desk sweep 108 passed; canon guards 24; repo guards 1062).

## Not verified
- Not seen live at 1440 and 393 with a real `used` result: the desk sweep has no seeded automation result with `used`; only the T2 render and the sweep's generic pass.
- Undo end to end (the desk delete receipt taking the note) is proven only to the `OBJECT_DELETE_REQUEST` dispatch; the receipt has its own tests.
- No real Claude Code or Codex run.
